export_evidence: importkey.com/countries/india/pet-plast-india (and slug variant 'pet-plast-india-') returned only the generic page shell: 'Shipments available for PET PLAST INDIA, refreshed daily' — a template placeholder, not a shipment row. Zero actual records seen: no date, no destination, no HS code, no bill-of-lading number. Second sources unavailable: volza.com/p/pet-plast-india → HTTP 403; eximpedia.app → HTTP 403; trademo.com → HTTP 403; importgenius.com → JavaScript challenge page. Bing exact-phrase query for '"PET PLAST INDIA" export shipment HS 841459' returned only unrelated US pet-retail results, i.e. no indexed trade record.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split located. Search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down for the whole session ('Connection refused'), so no domestic-supply source could be retrieved. Nothing to quote.
